BiblicalUsage: The moving of the lips is the comfort Job wishes he could give. He tells his friends he would strengthen them with his mouth, and the moving of his lips would assuage their grief — the words he longs for are the words they have not given him.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that lips can be medicine: Job knows the comfort he needed, and he promises it to the very friends who failed him.
